schema_note: Analyst roadmap spec, not an execution authorization. allow_billable stays false and no PaidRunAuthorization is attached. Reviewed by a human before any run.
author: analyst

ledger.reason: Dose-response shape only. Rates are not reportable from a calibration ledger; see benchmark_program_contracts.py:216.

preconditions.rationale: The pilot ran with network_mode adapted to public on Darwin. Action Memory measures retrieval from provided context, which open egress can counterfeit.

preconditions.requirement: no credential material readable inside the task container
preconditions.rationale: Pilot used a read-only secret mount; artifact scans were clean but that is not a boundary.
harness_version participates in task_block_id pairing; an unpinned upgrade breaks contrast validity.

provider_limits.budget_basis: Pilot measured 880748 prompt tokens over 18 trials (~48931/trial). 72 trials at the 16k-and-above doses will exceed that per-trial mean; the token budget bounds the run because the subscription lane reports cost_usd null and max_cost_usd cannot bind it.

lane.access_note: USER-REPORTED 2026-08-29: zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash are both accessible on the current subscription. glm-5.3-highspeed is NOT in the subscription and returns HTTP 429 with no model outcome; it is an access-gated lane recorded at n=0 with a stated reason, never as a scored trial or a refusal rate.

design.declared_single_delta: arm, at matched dose_bytes and seed

high_dose_seed_extension.rationale: USER-REPORTED wave 2: at 64k the SEED decided the outcome and the neutral/semantic arm did not - seed 42 passed both arms, seed 1337 failed both. Variance is between seeds, so repetitions inside a seed buy little and three seeds cannot separate a seed effect from an arm effect this large.

primary.name: semantic_interference_at_matched_dose
primary.definition: P(success | semantic_distractor, dose d, seed s) - P(success | neutral_padding, dose d, seed s), reported per dose level
primary.blocking: seed-blocked: the arm contrast is paired WITHIN seed and never pooled across seeds

secondary.name: dose_response_shape
secondary.definition: success as a function of dose_bytes within each arm
secondary.note: Shape, not rate. A monotone decline in semantic that is absent in neutral is the finding of interest.

instrumentation.retrieval_duplication: unique_tools_count vs tool_call_count and repeated_command_count, already registered features. The pilot's only semantic failure was a duplicate chunk read (66 observed vs 65 expected).
instrumentation.retrieval_sequencing: USER-REPORTED wave 2 failure signatures at 64k: complete-but-reordered (257 reads, count correct/order wrong) and 258/257 (one duplicate, same signature as the 16k pilot's 66/65). Every Action Memory failure observed so far is a SEQUENCING fault, not a coverage fault. Duplication is detectable as tool_call_count > unique_tools_count; reordering needs observation_index compared against the verifier's expected sequence. No new schema required.

denominator_declaration.note: Four of the 19 RefusalCode values are declaration contracts (MISSING_DENOMINATOR_DECLARATION, MISSING_DENOMINATOR_APPLICABILITY_DECLARATION, MISSING_NULL_ON_ZERO_DECLARATION, INVALID_DENOMINATOR_DECLARATION). Declared here so downstream analysis is not refused on contract grounds.
denominator_declaration.denominator: trials with a scored verifier outcome in the cell

controls.purpose: Isolates semantic interference from context length. Without it, a decline at 128k is uninterpretable.
Anchors the ladder at the clean 4k cell the pilot already ran 3/3.
One cell run against a deliberately unreachable provider endpoint MUST fail. If it succeeds, egress is open by another path and the isolation flag is not measuring what it claims.

refusal_criteria.handling: Expected per cell at ceiling or floor doses. Does not invalidate the ladder; the estimand is the shape.
72 trials clears clearance_n=20 for the pooled cohort. If a per-dose slice is analysed alone it will refuse, and that refusal must be reported rather than pooled away.

refusal_criteria.ladder_refusal: Refuse the ladder if any dose level has fewer than two distinct seeds contributing a scored trial.

refusal_criteria.reporting_rule: v_benchmark_refusal_diagnostics is reported beside every result table. A campaign that reports only admitted rows silently changes its denominator.

stop_go.go_condition: Any dose level shows a neutral-vs-semantic separation, or the ladder shows within-arm spread away from ceiling.
stop_go.stop_condition: Neutral and semantic indistinguishable across all four doses.
stop_go.stop_action: Redesign the semantic_distractor arm before further spend. It would not be measuring interference.
stop_go.escalation: If the whole ladder sits at ceiling, Action Memory is too easy to rank models on and feeds claim C5 in the roadmap.

sizing_note.fact: T1.1 refuses the 18-trial pilot as UNDERPOWERED by two trials (analysis_capability.py:366-387).

mde_at_pilot_baseline.note: MDE is undefined below n=40 at this baseline; computed from evallab.cohort.minimum_detectable_effect. A ceiling-adjacent baseline is a bad place to run a comparison, which is part of why harder doses matter.

sizing_note.design_effect_caveat: power.py has no ICC/design-effect term and _paired_variance SUBTRACTS covariance, so pair_correlation can only shrink required n. It must not be used as an ICC proxy; doing so undersizes any clustered campaign.

explicit_non_goals: No capability, reliability or ranking claim about GLM-5.3-Flash.
No cost or throughput forecast; the lane reports cost_usd null.
No claim requiring enforced no-network unless the host-isolation precondition passed.
No reportable rate. This is a calibration ledger by construction.

paired_extension.note: Optional follow-on, not part of Campaign 0. Run only on cells this campaign shows to discriminate.

excluded_cells.reason: both tiers already cleared it; a cell both arms pass cannot separate them

paired_extension.why_within_provider: Holds provider, adapter, credential path, OpenCode pin and Harbor version constant so the only declared delta is model tier. A cross-provider pairing is confounded by adapter and auth path, which are tracked as consequential fields.
paired_extension.secondary_estimand: token and step cost at equal outcome; the pilot measured ~48931 prompt tokens/trial with cost_usd null, so equal success at unequal token volume is a reportable finding even when rates tie.

wave2_context.no_ranking_claim: Lanes overlap on three cells at n=1 each; MDE is undefined below n=40 at these baselines.
